port_royal.name: Port Royal
port_royal.description: The wickedest city in the world. Buccaneer gold built its taverns, and its governor was once a buccaneer himself.

bridgetown.name: Bridgetown
bridgetown.description: Upwind of everything. Planters grow rich on sugar and fear for their ships every hurricane season.

basseterre.name: Basseterre
basseterre.description: St. Christopher is shared uneasily with the French. Both garrisons watch each other more than the sea.

havana.name: Havana
havana.description: Key to the New World. The treasure fleet gathers here under the guns of El Morro before the run home.

santo_domingo.name: Santo Domingo
santo_domingo.description: The oldest city of the Indies, proud and poor. Its cattle run wild and feed half the buccaneers of Tortuga.

cartagena.name: Cartagena
cartagena.description: The strongest walls on the Main. Gold and emeralds from New Granada pass through on their way to Spain.

portobelo.name: Portobelo
portobelo.description: A fever-ridden village that wakes once a year, when Peruvian silver arrives for the great fair.

veracruz.name: Veracruz
veracruz.description: Mexico's door to the sea. Silver from the mines of New Spain waits here for the flota.

maracaibo.name: Maracaibo
maracaibo.description: Sacked twice in living memory. Rich in cocoa, behind a shallow bar that big ships cannot cross.

tortuga.name: Tortuga
tortuga.description: A rock of buccaneers under a French flag. The governor asks few questions if his share arrives on time.

saint_pierre.name: Saint-Pierre
saint_pierre.description: The Paris of the Antilles, under the shadow of Mont Pelée. Rich in sugar and cocoa, short of everything else.

willemstad.name: Willemstad
willemstad.description: The Dutch trade with everyone, legally or not. Spanish colonists buy here what Spain cannot send them.

st_eustatius.name: St. Eustatius
st_eustatius.description: A free port on a volcanic rock. Warehouses line the beach and nobody checks whose flag a buyer sails under.

nassau.name: Nassau
nassau.description: A ruined settlement turned pirate roost. The shoals of the Bahama Banks keep the navies' big ships away.
